search_text: published ZDI-21-1026 ZDI-CAN-12686 (0Day) D-Link DIR-2055 HNAP PrivateLogin Incorrect Implementation of Authentication Algorithm Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2021-08-26 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['D-Link'] ['DIR-2055'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of D-Link DIR-2055 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of HNAP login requests. The issue results from the lack of proper implementation of the authentication algorithm. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the router.
